experienceTags: Occasion: Short pre-cut session, outdoor smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Dry earth, black pepper, cocoa and straightforward Nicaraguan tobacco carried through the Churchill without losing the direct Fuerte character. Pre-cutting it before lighting worked cleanly: the foot-end half still smoked properly and retained the blend. The profile stays pepper-led and fairly simple rather than highly complex, with a noticeable nicotine presence and a dry, savoury finish.
